text.content:
A strongroom given over entirely to tack: saddlebags stacked to the ceiling in every state of repair, bridles, bells, and enough spare leather to outfit a caravan twice the warren's size. Most of it is junk. Not all of it.

GM Notes

Breather: No active threat.

Subquest/lore - Where the Throne Came From: This is where every saddlebag the goblins have ever "promoted" to the Boss Arena's throne originally came from - a running joke among the goblins is that the throne gets reupholstered every time a chief falls out of favor. Buried under the pile, one saddlebag is genuinely fine work, unmistakably not goblin-made and not recent - a last physical trace of Old Tam's original stable-yard operation, worth a little coin and a nice bit of connective lore if the party's been following the Room 0/24 thread.
